query:
SELECT b.id, b.booking_date, b.status, b.client_email, b.vessel_name
FROM bookings b
WHERE b.vessel_name LIKE '%JETSKI%' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(b.booking_date/1000) >= '2025-11-29 00:00:00' AND FROM_UNIXTIME(b.booking_date/1000) < '2025-11-30 00:00:00'
ORDER BY b.booking_date;
